candidates.title: ceres_128_p
candidates.description: PLT shape of Ceres at 5.3 km resolution, 100K vectors. Images and kernels used to build the topography can be found in ceresimglist.txt and cereskernellist.txt, respectively.

candidates.title: ceres_512_i
candidates.description: ICQ shape of Ceres at 1.3 km resolution, 1.6M vectors. The 4th column is relative albedo. Images and kernels used to build the topography can be found in ceresimglist.txt and cereskernellist.txt, respectively.

candidates.title: ceres_albedo_c
candidates.description: SPC generated relative albedo. Average value is 0.5, with a range from 0 to 2. The albedo is in an equirectangular projection. Data file is stored in a USGS-native ISIS format.

candidates.title: ceres_numimg_c
candidates.description: Number of images in each 1 degree bin. Number of images is in an equirectangular projection. Data file is stored in a USGS-native ISIS format.

candidates.title: np65n73057_lat_c
candidates.description: Latitude values that correspond to the SPC generated topography. The data is not projected, but is close to North up, though deviations from North up may occur near the poles. Data file is stored in a USGS-native ISIS format.

candidates.title: np65n73057_topo_c
candidates.description: SPC generated topography. Given as elevation in meters relative to a datum of 470 km. The topography is not projected, but is close to North up, though deviations from North up may occur near the poles. Images and kernels used to build the topography can be found in np65imglist.txt and cereskernellist.txt, respectively. Data file is stored in a USGS-native ISIS format.

candidates.title: sp01s71031_lon_c
candidates.description: East Longitude values that correspond to the SPC generated topography. The data is not projected, but is close to North up, though deviations from North up may occur near the poles. Data file is stored in a USGS-native ISIS format.

candidates.title: sp02s70168_topo_c
candidates.description: SPC generated topography. Given as elevation in meters relative to a datum of 470 km. The topography is not projected, but is close to North up, though deviations from North up may occur near the poles. Images and kernels used to build the topography can be found in sp02imglist.txt and cereskernellist.txt, respectively. Data file is stored in a USGS-native ISIS format.

candidates.title: HST images, albedo maps, and shape of (1) Ceres V1.0
candidates.description: This dataset contains 267 HST ACS/HRC images of asteroid (1) Ceres obtained in 2003/2004 at three wavelengths, 535 nm, 335 nm, and 223 nm. They have been photometrically calibrated to standard reflectance unit I/F. The dataset also includes a shape for Ceres, as well as three surface albedo maps covering the area between +/-50 deg latitude, derived from these images.
